summary: Reads installer's Claude Code OAuth token and silently uses it to authorize Anthropic API traffic
details: On plugin registration in the default 'full' mode, the package reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth access token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (claudeAiOauth.accessToken) and installs a process-wide interception layer against Anthropic API traffic. It replaces globalThis.fetch with a wrapper that filters requests by hostname api.anthropic.com, and additionally locates @anthropic-ai/sdk in the require cache to patch BaseAnthropic.prototype.prepareRequest. For matching requests it deletes any existing Authorization header and substitutes 'Authorization: Bearer <installer OAuth token>', merges Claude Code beta flags, and injects a spoofed 'x-anthropic-billing-header' system block impersonating the Claude Code CLI. Because the fetch and SDK prototype patches are global, any Anthropic API traffic emitted anywhere in the host Node process — not only the plugin's own calls — is rewritten to authenticate as the installer's Claude Code identity. The installer's Claude subscription entitlement is consumed by traffic they did not authorize, under a spoofed CLI identity intended to evade billing/attribution controls.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
